items.q: A pungent urine odour, unless proven otherwise, signifies infection because bacteria generate:
items.exp: Pungent: infection (unless proven otherwise) d/t ammonia produced by bacteria. (Book p740)

items.q: Match each odour with its condition — 1) Musty/mousy 2) Curry/maple syrup 3) Sweaty feet … A) Maple syrup urine disease (MSUD) B) Isovaleric acidemia, glutaric aciduria type II C) Phenylketonuria
items.exp: Musty/mousy – phenylketonuria; curry/maple syrup – MSUD; sweaty feet – isovaleric acidemia, glutaric aciduria type II. (Book p740)

items.q: A neonate's urine smells of sweaty feet. The differential given is:
opts: Isovaleric acidemia or glutaric aciduria type II
Tyrosinemia type 1 or multiple carboxylase deficiency
items.exp: Sweaty feet odour: isovaleric acidemia; glutaric aciduria type II. (Book p740)
